A '''Kel Dor Sith Lord''' once reigned as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="JATM" /> At some point between 40 ABY<ref>''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> and 41 ABY,<ref>''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] engaged a group of [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in combat. The [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] had [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and wore [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Sith apparel|robes]] in conjunction with [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that protected the Sith's chest.<ref name="JATM" /> Because Kel Dor were unable to breathe [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]],<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> the Sith was forced to wear a set of protective [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] and an [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath mask]]. The Kel Dor was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and was powerful enough to ascend to the rank of Sith Lord. The Kel Dor was additionally capable of using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Tutaminis|channel]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire energy and turn it against enemy forces, using [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] against the troopers.<ref name="JATM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kel Dor Sith Lord appeared in an image created for the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', a [[2009]] resource guide for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The image was used to demonstrate a Force technique called "Channel energy." The Sith Lord was additionally pictured in the montage on the introductory chapter page.<ref name="JATM" />
